description: Migrate the authentication infrastructure from src/auth/ to libs/auth/ following the established libs pattern, while keeping the controller in src/auth/ since controllers are domain-specific. This refactoring separates authentication infrastructure (guards, strategies, decorators, service) from the domain-specific controller, making the auth infrastructure reusable and properly organized. The migration decouples AuthService from UsersService by introducing a user lookup provider interface, enabling better separation of concerns.
